scope_of_deliverables.quote:
3. Scope of solution

Solution area
Required scope
API management
API catalog, authentication, policy enforcement, throttling, analytics, developer onboarding, lifecycle management, and API-as-a-Service readiness.
Integration patterns
File-based, message-based, service-based, API-led, event-driven, batch, hybrid cloud/on-premises, and database-oriented integrations.
Data mapping and transformation
Graphical mapping, reusable templates, transformation rules, validation, exception handling, error reporting, and advanced/pro-code extensibility.
scope_of_deliverables.value: The RFP seeks a middleware solution with capabilities in API management, integration patterns, and data mapping and transformation. The solution should include API catalog, authentication, policy enforcement, and more, supporting various integration patterns and offering advanced data mapping and transformation features.

Operations Centralized monitoring, alerting, root-cause diagnostics, runbooks, rollback, deployment governance, support model, and service outage communication. Security Credential/secrets management, encryption in transit, least-privilege administration, role-based controls, auditability, and security protocol disclosure. Implementation Phased rollout, migration from legacy integrations, coexistence approach, testing/UAT scripts, training, knowledge transfer, and operating model transition.

evaluation_criteria.quote: Proposals will be evaluated based on the following criteria: Technical Evaluation Criteria • Demonstrated understanding of this RFP • Quality and clarity of the proposed approach and methodology • Resource requirements, migration approach, and risk • Validate RFP response claims through scripted scenarios, architecture review, security review, data model discussion, and operating model review. • Feasibility of the proposed activity plan and timeline, and appropriateness of time allocated to delivering each task • Relevant professional experience of the proposed vendor and implementation team • Quality and relevance of the sample work, references, and case studies submitted Financial Evaluation Criteria • Quality and clarity of budget provided, and level of detail included • Alignment of the budget to the activity timeline detailed in the technical proposal • Assess license/subscription model, implementation cost, support costs, and overall value • Adherence to the available budget

pricing_structure.quote: Commercial area Required pricing detail Software/subscription Base platform subscription, user tiers, environments, API calls, messages, transactions, data volume, connector costs, and optional modules. Implementation services Discovery, design, configuration, development, migration, testing, deployment, training, and project management. Support and managed services Support tiers, SLA options, 24/7/365 coverage, named support resources, managed operations, and support ticket reporting. Training and enablement Administrator, developer, operations, and user training; documentation; certification; knowledge transfer. Partner onboarding cost Effort and pricing model to onboard each new member, retailer, brand, supplier, traceability partner, or integration. Customization/pro-code support Rates, assumptions, ownership of code, portability, documentation, maintenance, and future enhancement costs. Exit and portability Data export costs, transition support, termination terms, data retention, and support for migration to future platforms.
pricing_structure.value: Provide pricing in the commercial response template, including software/subscription, implementation services, support, training, and optional modules.
